Abu Dhabi Darb Toll Calculator

Enter how many times you cross at peak times and on how many days, to see your daily, monthly and yearly Darb cost.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your Darb cost

7–9 AM and 3–7 PM. Crossings at other times are free.

Current Darb rules

  • Fee: AED 4 per crossing at peak times.
  • Peak: 7–9 AM and 3–7 PM, Monday to Saturday (the evening window was 5–7 PM before September 2025).
  • Free: all other times, Sundays and official public holidays.
  • Caps: the daily cap (previously AED 16) and the monthly cap for private vehicles were removed on 1 September 2025.

Example: an employee crossing two gates in the morning and two in the evening, five days a week: 4 × AED 4 = AED 16 a day, AED 80 a week and about AED 346 a month.

Frequently asked questions

How much is the Darb toll in Abu Dhabi?

AED 4 per crossing at peak times: 7–9 AM and 3–7 PM, Monday to Saturday. Crossings at other times are free.

Were the Darb daily and monthly caps removed?

Yes. Since 1 September 2025 there is no daily or monthly cap for private vehicles, so every peak crossing costs AED 4.

Is Darb free on Sunday?

Yes, crossings are free on Sundays and official public holidays.

Who is exempt from Darb fees?

Eligible groups remain exempt, including people of determination, low-income families, senior citizens and retirees, after registering on the platform.
